messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered - service: inference-gateway - alert: 5xx error-rate spike - current 5xx rate 18% (baseline ~1%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Region: us-west2. Auto-page to oncall.

pagerduty: Pager fired -> Escalation policy: inference-oncall. Incident link: https://pd.redwood.example/incidents/INC-8469

alice (oncall): acked :hand:

alice (oncall): seeing lots of backend 502 from sidecar-proxy. Errors spread across multiple pods in us-west2.

ben: pulling logs now. running:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference-gateway | egrep "5[0-9]{2}|upstream reset" | tail -n 80
```

carol: any config push or rollout in the last 30m?

alice (oncall): no deploys from platform in last hour. metrics show upstream latency increasing and timeouts.

ben: found repeated 'upstream reset' and 'rc: ECONNRESET' in envoy logs. Looks like connection resets to the model sidecars. Investigating network vs sidecar overload.

sre-lead: if sidecars overloaded, try reducing weight to us-west2 and shift to eu-west1 as fallback. Also consider enabling degraded model variant for heavy customers.

alice (oncall): executing traffic shift to reduce load on problematic AZ. Doing via routing-service.

alice (oncall): commands:
```
routingctl set-weight embeddings-service us-west2=60 eu-west1=40 --dry-run
routingctl set-weight embeddings-service us-west2=60 eu-west1=40
```

ben: starting KV cache warmup on eu-west1 and spinning up +2 sidecar replicas there. Kickoff warmup script now.

carol: I'll ping CS to surface impact to top customers. acme.co flagged as seeing ~30% failures in logs last 10m.

alice (oncall): PagerDuty escalation timer in 10m if errors don't trend down.

incident-bot: Runbook note appended: inference-gateway 5xx spike — actions taken: routing shift, scale eu-west1, KV warmup, sidecar worker tuning.

ben: after weight shift and extra replicas, observed us-west2 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 4% over 8 minutes. Embeddings success rate improving in eu-west1.

alice (oncall): handing off -> ben: i'm stepping out for a quick break. ben you're the owner now, please keep PD assigned.

ben: taking over. I'll keep monitoring; plan: monitor 15m, then rollback if stable. ETA full recovery 30-45m.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by ben.

ben: root cause hypothesis: malformed keepalive/connection resets from upstream CDN -> overwhelmed sidecar connections leading to resets. Applied sidecar connection tuning and increased worker pool + connection timeout bump.

carol: customer comms prepared: status page update and targeted emails to acme.co & beta-corp drafted.

ben: 5xx held at ~0.8% for last 10m. No customer escalations reported after the status update.

incident-bot: If stable for 20m, suggest resolving on PD. Follow-up: schedule postmortem + check CDN keepalive config.

ben: marking incident as mitigated. Will close PD in 5m if remains stable.

incident-bot: Incident resolved - inference-gateway 5xx spike mitigated. Summary: routing weight shift, eu-west1 scale + KV warmup, sidecar connection tuning. Postmortem scheduled.
